name: Grace Barnet
source: The newly-minted captain of the Mutiny!! She is coquettish, sultry, smart. Because of her faint expressions, It’s hard to say whether you’re being teased or not when she speaks to you. As a harlot she was tricked by the previous captain into taking ownership of a boat and all the debt on it.
